description: This file implements the sqlstore for auto-translation features in Mattermost, including methods for retrieving, saving, and managing translation data and user preferences related to auto-translation in channels.

classes.name: SqlAutoTranslationStore
classes.description: Struct implementing the AutoTranslationStore interface for managing auto-translation data in SQL database.

methods.name: IsUserEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a user has auto-translation enabled in a specific channel.

methods.name: GetUserLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred language of a user in a specific channel.

methods.name: GetActiveDestinationLanguages
methods.description: Gets a list of active destination languages for a channel, optionally filtering by user IDs.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Fetches a translation record for a given object and destination language.

methods.name: GetBatch
methods.description: Retrieves multiple translations for a list of object IDs and a destination language.

methods.name: GetAllForObject
methods.description: Gets all translations associated with a specific object.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves or updates a translation record in the database.

methods.name: GetByStateOlderThan
methods.description: Retrieves translations with a specific state older than a given timestamp.

methods.name: GetLatestPostUpdateAtForChannel
methods.description: Returns the latest update timestamp for post translations in a channel.

methods.name: GetTranslationsSinceForChannel
methods.description: Fetches translations updated since a specific timestamp for a channel.

methods.name: InvalidateUserAutoTranslation
methods.description: Placeholder for invalidating user auto-translation cache.

methods.name: InvalidateUserLocaleCache
methods.description: Placeholder for invalidating user locale cache.

methods.name: InvalidatePostTranslationEtag
methods.description: Placeholder for invalidating post translation ETag.
